planning_configuration_selection.selection_data: The fixed offline dev subset from validation trajectories; see offline_diagnostic_pairs.json.
planning_configuration_selection.method: Select the three default planning hyperparameters using the four dev metric groups.
planning_configuration_selection.closed_loop_role: Report navigation performance in unseen scenes; main results and configuration comparisons share the same fixed Clean150 tasks.
planning_configuration_selection.dev_role: Provide complementary analysis of internal model behavior.
planning_configuration_selection.search_scope: Limited hyperparameter search; the experiments prioritize evaluating the intention first architecture over exhaustive performance optimization.
